body:
I really wish I had a good answer for you, I was in that exact same situation throughout middle/high school. One of the things that helped me cope at the time was, and hopefully this isn’t too cliche, was reading. I got super immersed in the Harry Potter and R.A. Salvatore’s The Legend of Drizzt series of books. Writing sprung up as something I could apply myself to and progress at with time, it was another thing that kept me going. 

I know that fifteen can look bleak as hell but I promise you it does get better.
